result.title: "Deep lifts": Neural networks can generalize even with the dumbest optimizer
result.summary: Given a labeled dataset $\{(x_i, y_i)\}_{i = 1}^n$, consider drawing a parameter vector $\hatθ$ uniformly at random from those that interpolate the data within a width-$W$ depth-$D$ ReLU architecture with continuous weights bounded within $[-M, M]$. We study the generalization properties of $\hatθ$ in the case where the dataset can, in fact, be explained by a smaller $w$-by-$d$ ReLU network. Despite the obliviousness of the selection rule for $\hatθ$, it adaptively generalizes at the rate $\tilde O\left(\frac{wdWD}{n}\right)$, rather than being governed by the VC dimension of the full $W$-by-$D$ hypothesis class. The reason is due to a particular inductive bias in ReLU networks: the $w$-by-$d$ parameter *witnesses* an exponential volume of $W$-by-$D$ interpolating parameters, which dwarfs the volume of poorly generalizing parameters (conditioned on interpolation). We explicitly construct this set of near-equivalent $W$-by-$D$ parameters by a proof technique called *deep lifting*, and then tie the achievable volume to stability properties of the $w$-by-$d$ witness. Examples show that these techniques allow us to convert approximation-theoretic results into generalization guarantees for nonparametric classes. We further show that generalization of uniform-random interpolators can survive label corruptions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究随机抽取的插值参数在小网络「证人」存在时为何仍能泛化：作者用「deep lifting」构造出指数级体量的近等价大网络参数集合，把泛化率绑定到小网络的稳定性性质，并展示可将逼近论结果转成非参数类的泛化保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是「同一函数对应指数级近等价参数/状态集合」的表示几何论证，可能与 LVR 中多种 latent 假设、表示冗余与等价类评价的思考有概念联系，但属推测，需人工核查是否有可迁移的形式化工具。
